Alicia (PM): quick sync — sprint end next Tue. proposal: we fence scope so we can hit a reliable MVP. my suggested cutlist below, need alignment by EOD.

Ben (Eng): real talk — embeddings cache + per-tenant autoscaler are the biggest eng hits. cutting them buys ~2–3 weeks and simplifies infra.

Cara (Design): UX note — removing embeddings cache will degrade suggestion accuracy in search/recs. we can ship with a ‘beta’ badge + inline copy explaining performance limitations. small work.

Dmitri (SRE): if we keep model-pinning on hosted, we need extra routing and metrics. suggest restrict model-pinning to Dedicated for MVP to avoid infra churn.

Alicia (PM): proposal for decision:
```
MVP (launch slice):
- Core chat + streaming responses (must)
- Region routing + basic telemetry (must)
- Defer: embeddings cache, per-tenant autoscaler, advanced reranking (v1)
- SAML: Dedicated-only canary for Acme pilot; hosted SAML -> v1
```
Approve/objects?

Eva (ProductOps): +1 from ops perspective. will create feature-flagging tasks and rollout checklist (feature-flag, metrics, rollback).

Frank (Sales): heads-up: Acme expects SAML in pilot. if we move hosted SAML to v1 they might delay sign-off. can we offer a Dedicated pilot with SAML enabled?

Ben (Eng): we can support a Dedicated SAML pilot but need infra reservations and a small ops runbook. estimate: 5 full dev days to stand up and secure.

Dmitri (SRE): confirm — Dedicated pilot is feasible but request: clear start/end dates and a frozen infra request ticket so we don't accidentally autoscale it away.

Alicia (PM): decision summary:
- Lock MVP cutlist as above.
- Offer Acme a Dedicated SAML pilot (short-term) — Ben + Dmitri to scope infra and ETA.
- Eva to open feature-flag + rollout tickets.
- Cara to update UI copy and add beta badges for impacted screens.
- Frank to sync with Acme on Dedicated pilot offer and temp timeline.

Ben (Eng): I'll drop a PRD section with the infra estimate by EOD.

Eva (ProductOps): created tickets: PF-824 (feature flags), RL-199 (rollout checklist). linking in the PRD. :white_check_mark:

Frank (Sales): I'll tell Acme they can start a Dedicated pilot next-week if infra is green. thanks.

Alicia (PM): great — i'll update the product doc and ping this thread when PRD is updated. thanks everyone. :raised_hands:

deploy-bot: Scheduled weekly deploy paused for the next 48h to accommodate Dedicated pilot infra changes.``
